entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was bottling up my feelings for so long.[n]I just did what I was told, putting up with[n]everything that came my way...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have to be thankful to her. To Johanna.[n]She helped me break free of those[n]chains and rode by my side.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I suppose it's a little strange to be[n]thanking a piece of my own heart,[n]though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I totally get you, though. I feel the same[n]way about my own.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Someday, I'd like to tell her... Thank you[n]for fighting with me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When Makoto awakened, I knew one[n]thing for sure.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I am NEVER gonna mess with her.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I know what you mean.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She took one step and shattered the[n]floor... I'm afraid to think about what'd[n]happen if she turned that foot on me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That stuff you said when you awakened[n]really stuck with me. Why do you think[n]we always put up with things like that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Speaking up can cause trouble for others.[n]Even when something's not right, it feels[n]like there's nothing we can do...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thinking that way ruled over my life. I[n]kept myself constrained to a tiny box.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sure we're not the only ones who[n]felt that way.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hope that with the Phantom Thieves,[n]we can help more people have the[n]courage to speak up for themselves.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes... That is my wish.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What is it, Mako-chan?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm just thinking about the day I met[n]Johanna.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sometimes... I wonder whether the[n]things I do are really right or wrong.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It can be hard to tell, huh...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I have no doubt, Mako-chan. Your[n]words have touched my life personally.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Haru...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm so glad we all met.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'd never seen a vehicle-type Persona[n]before this one. Makoto's a natural at[n]riding it, too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you think would happen if[n]it evolved? Maybe it'd turn into a huge[n]truck or airplane.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder... I suppose I wouldn't mind[n]something like that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If that were the case... Would my other[n]form be useless?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Damn, she's a beaut. Ya think this[n]belongs to a biker gang?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... don't think that's the case.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Well, I've seen a helluva lot in my day,[n]but a bike this tricked out is a new one.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Never thought those guys hung around[n]Tokyo, but I guess there's at least one[n]enthusiast around here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah... I suppose.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'd love to go on a roadtrip with a beefy[n]bike like this.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, now's the time. You're still young.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you wait until you settle down and run[n]a shop or somethin' like me, it'll be a[n]whole lot to find the time.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ooh! Wise words from the experienced![n]Maybe I will take a trip across the[n]country, then...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must apologize for the way I acted[n]back then.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Back then? What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The day you went to meet with[n]Kaneshiro and ended up being taken[n]hostage.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I said your actions were ludicrous...[n]But if you hadn't done so, we never[n]would have gained access to the Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Was it that harsh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It was. I deeply apologize.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You were only speaking the truth. Don't[n]worry, I'm not upset about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, that was so rad. I get pumped[n]every time I think about it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thnk about what?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Your awakening, duh!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji's right. You looked so fierce, and[n]then drove straight into those Shadows.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah! You blasted away, like, fifty[n]of 'em!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hold on! Aren't you exaggerating a little?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Johanna is sooo cool!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I agree! It's neat to see a Persona that[n]looks like a motorcycle.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've never ridden one before. I have to[n]say, I'm a little envious.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ditto.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then why don't we all get motorcycle[n]licenses? That way, we can go on a[n]road trip together.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh! That would be wonderful!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I can't even ride a bike without training[n]wheels...
